facts.meaning: v5 calls error after 2027-01-26; merge target 2026-12-15.
v1 base is https://api.ads.apple.com/v1; top-level resources, ad-account context and result envelopes replace legacy shapes (pp.6–7).
Existing external token custody remains: client_credentials, searchadsorg, one-hour tokens; no plugin OAuth implementation.

GET /v1/acls has no account header; result.acls entries contain adAccount identity and roles. Scoped calls use X-AP-Context. Explicit ad-account reselection required; ACLs do not establish currency/timezone.

POST /v1/campaigns/query sends sorting and pagination offset/pageSize/fetchTotalCount. Decode result and pagination offset/pageSize/totalCount. Validate bounded error code/message/details; discard raw text.
Create with adAccountId, APPSTORE_APP/promotedObjectId, dailyBudget.value, finite schedule, include targeting and matched MANUAL_CPT/TAP strategy. Plugin always sends PAUSED.
result campaign includes adAccountId, approved configuration, systemStatus and deleted. Documented date examples omit the UTC suffix.
Require PAUSED advertiser intent and independent non-serving system status plus non-deletion.
POST /v1/adgroups and GET /v1/adgroups/{id}; campaignId is carried in creation body, Search Match is supported, readback uses systemStatus.
App Store targeting includes countryOrRegion, supplySource APPSTORE and supplyPlacement APPSTORE_SEARCH_RESULTS. Ad-group pricingModel CPT uses bidStrategy.bid with TAP goal.
POST /v1/ads and GET /v1/ads/{id}; creation includes adGroupId, creativeId, name/status. Current docs mark campaignId/adAccountId read-only; omit them from creation.
GET /v1/creatives/{id}; destination.parameters.adamId identifies the app. Require App Store destination and VALID system status.
Creative result supplies account identity and deleted; require matching ID/account and deleted:false.

unsupported: Reporting date inclusion/watermarks/freshness/finality/restatements: no report command or capability exists
Create idempotency, browser OAuth, Apple Maps, keywords, creative creation, activation and conversions
integrationNeeds: Explicit ad-account reselection and server origin/account binding
Integrator-owned capability declarations once reporting is supported; keep admission disabled
Launch-objective compatibility, production metadata, packaging and host acceptance
scope: Run A only: v1 reads and PAUSED creation/readback, durable checkpoints and GET-only reconciliation; reporting disabled. Fixtures only; tests unrun. No dependencies, contracts or migrations added.
